name.zh: 3. 设计质量与可靠性（含前期物料选型与准入）
name.en: 3. Design Quality & Reliability (Early Component Selection & Qualification)

intent.zh: 确认设计阶段内建可靠性与可制造性，并以规范与证据闭环
intent.en: Ensure the design stage embeds reliability and manufacturability with standards and evidence-driven closure.

questions.id: design-3-1-静电-浪涌与系统级保护-esd-surge

text.zh: 是否在设计阶段明确各接口/关键器件的系统级 ESD/Surge 目标并完成方案验证（含带电插拔/瞬变），且设计变更会触发复核？
text.en: Do we define system-level ESD/Surge targets per interface or critical component, validate the solution (including hot-plug/transients), and trigger revalidation whenever the design changes?

zh.1: 无 ESD/Surge 设计规范，依赖个人经验处理接口保护。
zh.2: 有零散 ESD/Surge 经历但缺统一器件 BOM 与记录。
zh.3: 形成 ESD/Surge 规范并完成关键接口预验证与等级记录。
zh.4: 器件、布局、预验证闭环稳定，充电口保护与 Latch-up 测试达标。
zh.5: 自动化 DRC 与器件库维护，变更触发复核并持续跟踪相关性。

en.1: No ESD/Surge design standards; interface protection relies on personal experience.
en.2: Scattered ESD/Surge learnings without a unified component BOM or records.
en.3: ESD/Surge guidelines established with pre-validation and level records for key interfaces.
en.4: Components, layout, and pre-validation form a stable loop; charging port protection and latch-up tests meet targets.
en.5: Automated DRC and component libraries are maintained; changes trigger revalidation with ongoing correlation tracking.

focus: 规范：ESD/Surge 设计指南（器件/布局/接地/回流）
保护：接口 TVS/滤波/共模扼流 BOM（USB-C/SIM/天线/显示/按键）
预验证：IEC 61000-4-2 目标等级记录；Latch-up/JEDEC 测试
充电口：OVP/OCP/OTP；带电插拔/EFT 场景
ask: 目标 ESD/Surge 等级是多少？
关键接口的 TVS BOM 与布局如何验证？
是否进行带电插拔/EFT/Latch-up 预验证？
threshold: 接触放电≥8kV，空气放电≥15kV
异常失效注入通过且无复位

focus: Standards: ESD/Surge design guidelines (components/layout/grounding/return paths)
Protection: interface TVS/filter/common-mode choke BOMs (USB-C/SIM/antenna/display/buttons)
Pre-validation: IEC 61000-4-2 target level records; latch-up/JEDEC tests
Charging port: OVP/OCP/OTP and hot-plug/EFT scenarios
ask: What ESD/Surge levels do we design for?
How do we validate the TVS BOM and layout for critical interfaces?
Do we run hot-plug/EFT/latch-up pre-validation?
threshold: Contact discharge ≥8 kV, air discharge ≥15 kV
Fault-injection and abnormal conditions pass with no resets

text.zh: 是否建立 PDN 目标阻抗并完成 SI/PI 联合仿真与板测相关性校核，对高速/大电流轨有明确去耦与布局约束？
text.en: Have we defined PDN target impedance, completed SI/PI co-simulation with board correlation, and set explicit decoupling/layout constraints for high-speed and high-current rails?

zh.1: 无 PDN 目标阻抗或 SI-PI 仿真，去耦方案凭经验。
zh.2: 仅经验摆放电容，缺少量化指标或仿真记录。
zh.3: 制定 PDN 目标并开展仿真与眼图分析。
zh.4: 仿真与板上测量一致，去耦与眼图报告形成闭环。
zh.5: 持续监控版本间相关性，PDN 目标与变更复核联动。

en.1: No PDN target impedance or SI/PI simulation; decoupling is experience-based.
en.2: Capacitors placed by experience with no quantified metrics or simulation records.
en.3: PDN targets are defined with simulations and eye diagram analysis.
en.4: Simulation aligns with board measurements; decoupling and eye diagram reports close the loop.
en.5: Correlation across versions is monitored; PDN targets link with change rechecks.

focus: 目标：PDN 目标阻抗（频域/时域）
去耦：电容网络方案与布局回路
高速：MIPI/USB/DDR 眼图/BER 报告
一致性：仿真 vs 板上测量对比
ask: Ztarget 如何定义与验证？
仿真与板测差异如何评估？
DFMEA 高风险如何触发专项仿真？
模型如何校准与版本化？
threshold: 关键频段阻抗满足目标并留余量
高速接口通过协议限值
高风险项均建立仿真验证闭环

focus: Targets: PDN impedance goals (frequency/time domain)
Decoupling: capacitor network strategy and layout loops
High-speed: MIPI/USB/DDR eye diagram and BER reports
Correlation: simulation versus board measurements
ask: How is Ztarget defined and verified?
How do we assess differences between simulation and board measurements?
How do DFMEA high-risk items trigger dedicated simulations?
How are models calibrated and versioned?
threshold: Impedance meets targets with margin at critical bands
High-speed interfaces meet protocol limits
High-risk items all have simulation and verification closure

text.zh: 是否完成结构 FEA 与关键工况（跌落/扭转/挤压/密封压缩量等）验证，并与型式试验（如 IP 等级）一致？
text.en: Have we completed structural FEA and key-condition validation (drop/twist/compression/seal squeeze) and aligned with type tests such as IP ratings?

zh.1: 仅做零散结构实测，无 CAE 或标准支撑。
zh.2: 尚未建立系统 CAE 模型，评估多依赖经验。
zh.3: 能执行 CAE 或实测其一，覆盖主要跌落/扭转/IP 场景。
zh.4: CAE 与实测互相校验，IP 型式与耐蚀测试达到目标。
zh.5: 建立参数库与公差链分析，结构/密封变更自动触发复核。

en.1: Only ad-hoc structural tests with no CAE or standards support.
en.2: Systematic CAE models not yet established; evaluations rely on experience.
en.3: Either CAE or physical testing is in place covering major drop/torsion/IP scenarios.
en.4: CAE correlates with physical tests; IP certification and corrosion tests meet targets.
en.5: Parameter libraries and tolerance-chain analysis exist; structural/seal changes auto-trigger reviews.

focus: FEA：跌落/扭转/点载 CAE 与实测闭环
连接：螺钉/卡扣/胶粘结构强度与疲劳
IP：密封胶圈压缩量、公差链；透气件布置
耐蚀：汗液/盐雾风险点
ask: CAE 如何与实测比对？
密封公差链如何计算？
threshold: 1.5m 六面多次功能正常
IP 目标与耐蚀要求达成

focus: FEA: drop/torsion/point-load CAE with test correlation
Connections: screw/clip/adhesive strength and fatigue
IP: seal compression, tolerance chain, and vent placement
Corrosion: sweat/salt-spray risk points
ask: How do CAE results correlate with physical tests?
How is the sealing tolerance stack calculated?
threshold: 1.5 m six-face drops multiple times with functional pass
IP targets and corrosion requirements achieved

text.zh: 是否进行稳态与瞬态热仿真并与实测对比，明确节流/降额策略与结温/触感控制目标？
text.en: Do we run steady-state and transient thermal simulations, compare against measurements, and define throttling/derating strategies plus junction/touch temperature targets?

zh.1: 无热设计仿真或节流策略，依靠经验排布。
zh.2: 仅有稳态仿真或零散测温，缺少校准基准。
zh.3: 完成稳态仿真并进行关键点测温校核。
zh.4: 稳态与瞬态 CFD 与实测偏差受控，节流与降额策略闭环。
zh.5: 电热耦合模型与寿命评估联动，热点监控与策略自动更新。

en.1: No thermal simulations or throttling strategy; rely on experience.
en.2: Only steady-state sims or scattered temperature checks without calibration.
en.3: Steady-state simulations completed with key-point temperature correlation.
en.4: Steady and transient CFD align with measurements; throttling and derating strategies are closed.
en.5: Electro-thermal models connect to life assessment; hotspot monitoring updates strategies automatically.

focus: 工况：拍摄/5G/游戏/充电 场景功耗
仿真：稳态+瞬态 CFD；测温点对比
方案：石墨片/VC/TIM；节流策略曲线
降额：热致降额与寿命
ask: 仿真实测偏差控制在多少？
节流策略触发点如何设定？
threshold: 触感温度满足目标
结温低于器件上限
充电热稳定验证通过

focus: Scenarios: power profiles for camera/5G/gaming/charging
Simulation: steady and transient CFD with measurement alignment
Solutions: graphite/VC/TIM; throttling curves
Derating: thermal derating and lifetime
ask: What deviation is maintained between simulation and measurement?
How are throttling triggers defined?
threshold: Surface touch temperature meets targets
Junction temperature stays below component limits
Charging thermal stability verification passed

text.zh: 是否建立射频/天线性能/TRP/TIS 预算并完成 EM 仿真与 OTA 实测相关性校核，且结构变更具备复核机制？
text.en: Have we built RF/antenna performance and TRP/TIS budgets, correlated EM simulations with OTA measurements, and established rechecks for structural changes?

zh.1: 仅关注 S11 等基础匹配，无 OTA 预算或仿真。
zh.2: 零散开展 3D EM 或 OTA 其中一项，缺系统预算。
zh.3: 具备 3D EM 仿真或 OTA 测试，并对效率/匹配进行评估。
zh.4: EM 与 OTA 数据一致性可证明，余量与结构变更有复核。
zh.5: 建立余量预算与变更触发机制，持续监控 MIMO/SAR 数据闭环。

en.1: Only basic S11 matching considered; no OTA budgets or simulations.
en.2: Occasional 3D EM or OTA work without a systematic budget.
en.3: 3D EM simulation or OTA testing exists with efficiency and matching evaluation.
en.4: EM and OTA data correlation is proven; margins and structural changes are rechecked.
en.5: Margin budgets and change triggers are in place with continuous MIMO/SAR monitoring and closure.

focus: EM：3D 天线/整机仿真（FEM/FDTD）
余量：效率/带宽/匹配容差；MIMO 相关性
影响：结构件/屏蔽/地弹片变更复核
合规：SAR 初评
ask: 仿真与 OTA 数据如何对齐？
多姿态 OTA 结果是否满足？
DFMEA 高风险如何触发专项仿真？
模型如何校准与版本化？
threshold: 关键频段余量满足预算并留裕量
高风险项均建立仿真验证闭环

focus: EM: 3D antenna/system simulations (FEM/FDTD)
Margins: efficiency/bandwidth/matching tolerance; MIMO correlation
Impact: structural components/shielding/spring-finger change revalidations
Compliance: preliminary SAR evaluation
ask: How do simulation and OTA data align?
Do multi-position OTA results meet expectations?
How do DFMEA high-risk items trigger dedicated simulations?
How are models calibrated and versioned?
threshold: Critical band margins meet budget with headroom
High-risk items all have simulation and verification closure

questions.id: design-3-7-条件触发的必要仿真-按-dfmea-高风险触发

text.zh: 是否基于 DFMEA/风险评估定义条件触发的专项验证（如耐腐蚀/化学品/高低温循环等），并将其纳入设计 Entry/Exit？
text.en: Have we defined DFMEA/risk-triggered special verifications (corrosion, chemicals, thermal cycling, etc.) and wired them into design Entry/Exit gates?

zh.1: 无条件触发仿真策略，DFMEA 高风险未覆盖。
zh.2: 仅零散执行个别专项仿真，缺触发标准与记录。
zh.3: 依据 DFMEA 触发主要专项仿真，但闭环与验证不完全。
zh.4: 触发条件、仿真与验证闭环形成台账，可追溯至项目风险。
zh.5: 仿真模型与参数库维护完备，与变更/风险阈值联动自动复核。

en.1: No conditional simulation strategy; DFMEA high risks remain uncovered.
en.2: Only occasional special simulations without trigger criteria or records.
en.3: DFMEA triggers major special simulations, but closure and verification are incomplete.
en.4: Trigger conditions, simulations, and verification closure are logged and traceable to project risks.
en.5: Simulation models and parameter libraries are maintained with automatic rechecks tied to change/risk thresholds.

focus: 公差链 Monte-Carlo（贴合/光轴/密封/卡扣）
相机专项（MTF/SFR、OIS/AF 寿命）
声学/振动（腔体、Mic、NVH）
EMC 预分析（谐振/屏蔽/滤波）
电池模型（循环寿命、极耳温升热点）
ask: 评审参与角色有哪些？
整改闭环如何追踪？
DFMEA 高风险如何触发专项仿真？
模型如何校准与版本化？
evidence: 专项仿真报告与模型文件
threshold: 关键可制造风险闭环并有复盘
高风险项均建立仿真验证闭环

focus: Tolerance-chain Monte Carlo (assembly/alignment/sealing/clips)
Camera-specific checks (MTF/SFR, OIS/AF life)
Acoustics/vibration (cavity, mic, NVH)
EMC pre-analysis (resonance/shielding/filtering)
Battery models (cycle life, tab hotspot rise)
ask: Who participates in the reviews?
How is corrective closure tracked?
How do DFMEA high-risk items trigger dedicated simulations?
How are models calibrated and versioned?
evidence: Corrective action list and validation records
Special simulation reports and model files
threshold: Critical manufacturability risks are closed with retrospectives
High-risk items all have simulation and verification closure
